BiblicalUsage: Hiddekel is the Tigris, one of the four rivers of Eden, and it appears again at the end of Daniel's visions. In Genesis it flows east of Assyria out of the garden, and in Daniel the prophet stands by the bank of the great river when the man clothed in linen appears to him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the river that watered Eden still runs through the visions, because God's story is one river from beginning to end.
